title: Quiet Gears
summary: Mara needs fuel and food, and the children must learn to stay silent.

beats.text: Sol's cry rolled down the road. I whispered a song until he stopped.
Heads turned between the cars. I coasted the bus into a ditch.
Silence for an hour. Ollie wrote the rules on a seat.
beats.speaker: ollie

beats.text: At dawn I walked to the supermarket alone. The shelves were half bare.
Water, bread, a can of fuel, and a bell for a bicycle.
I threw the bell far down the aisle. They shuffled after it.
A man waved from the pumps, ashen but upright. "You're the bus lady. I'm Dell."
beats.speaker: dell

beats.text: "Your muffler is cracked," Dell said. "They hear you for miles."
beats.speaker: dell

beats.text: Behind us, thirty shapes stepped out of the fog. Ollie whispered, "Mara. Don't start it."
beats.speaker: ollie
